name: Dragon CRS-26
about: Dragon CRS-26 (2022-159A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2 Cargo), launched 2022 Nov 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2022 Nov 26), held fixed
docked to A09460; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
